questions: Did H6 produce a valid method judgment or only a protocol-abort judgment?
Is the throughput loss localized to KL behavior work, rollout, PPO, or asymmetric concurrent workload?
What is the smallest next registered design that restores a contemporaneous fair baseline without reclassifying H6?
Is the HYBRID route family exhausted?
candidate_actions: H7 fresh contemporaneous control and treatment with all mirrors/evaluations deferred until both trainer endpoints are frozen
abandon KL early-stop and select a different HYBRID method family
decision_rule: Select H7 only if H6 is terminal strictly on protocol, implementation remains offline-valid, early-stop work cannot explain a two-sided collect/PPO slowdown, and treatment-only concurrent evaluation is a frozen resource asymmetry. Otherwise re-rank a distinct family. Route exhaustion requires all hybrid families to be causally exhausted.
inference_limits: Resource asymmetry may justify corrected prospective design but may not reclassify H6, impute endpoint efficacy, or authorize official hands.
